name: Theo
source:
Cecil's younger brother, a boy who lives with other orphans in the slums.
His personality is so gentle that he can't even kill an insect. He became ill and blind from malnutrition at an early age.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=842266&gc=gc]Getchu[/url]]
